I replied to Dana in their DM: I couldn't find a cutoff date for the Brackenwater Freight Co. paperwork in anything they have access to.

- **Where I looked:** the channels Dana is in (#north-team, #north-random, #general and the QFL incident room), the North team digests and cheat sheet, and Dana's calendar and mail. None of them gives a cutoff date. There's also no Brackenwater account or contract folder in the files Dana can open.
- **Ownership:** the North pipeline digest from 14 Sept 2025 says Brackenwater moved to Marcus Lindqvist on 15 Sept 2025. Dana may no longer own the account, so I pointed them to Marcus or June Osei-Lark (deal desk).

I didn't search Marcus's DM or any other channel Dana isn't in. I offered to look again if Dana can say where the date came up.
